name: John Middlekauff
photoSource: Official 3 & Out with John Middlekauff YouTube channel avatar (@3andout_pod, s900). X avatar @JohnMiddlekauff was a full-body outdoor shot, not a usable face.

calls.claim: I think Seattle. I don't know if the game looks exactly like last year. I don't expect. It's week one. … But to me, this is a 10-point game by Seattle.
calls.reasoning: He believes in Mike Macdonald's operation and Sam Darnold. New England's injured backs and left tackle make this a bad Week 1 matchup; he still sees it closer than last year's Super Bowl.
calls.subject: Seahawks
